name: vm_native_q1core_c-c-COMMIT
purpose: SE/NE core-only VM bank (H-NETLIST d4f 1b42352f8: q1 master with dq, rq1/rq2, wq1 absent) native closure for the vmb_SE/NE0..7 hoist.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hfd_vms_bank_native_q1_core u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/physical/hfd_vms_bank_native_q1_core.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/physical/hfd_vms_bank_native_q1.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_bank_static_strap.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_ce_counter_pipe.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/vm_native_q1core_c/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/vm_native_q1core_c/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/vm_native_q1core_c --out {RUN}/record/views/hfd_vms_bank_native_q1_core --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: q1_core (q1 master minus dq/rq1/rq2/wq1, H-NETLIST 1b42352f8) on the q0C geometry: 270x313.2, 20.136 um SRAM channels, balanced CTS sink clustering 16/30 um (C recipe); single clk root (the master has no face/macro clock ports, RTL unchanged); recipe-3 input pin flops as nat2.
